rootCause.production: Installed adapters call inject/core.mjs buildDigest, which clamps toolInput to serialized JSON strings. firstTouchPaths and grepLookupSubject treated these strings as objects, so installed inputs yielded neither path nor lookup; direct-object tests and endpoint replay missed this boundary.
rootCause.fixture: Ordinary CLI capability:read returns numbered text; the fixture demanded JSON. Explicit documented byte-page mode returns the exact base64 bytes needed by the assertion.
rootCause.detector: Native child error capture required a colon after Error headers. Node assert(false, empty-message) emits AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION] with no colon, so noisy cleanup hid the primary grep assertion.
rootCause.guard: Shared bounded decoder accepts only complete JSON objects; truncated, malformed, oversized, primitive and array digests remain quiet. Maintained tests cover native Read/Edit names and serialized grep; noisy-cleanup child tests cover both Error header forms.
